description: August 9 birthday meaning: Leo decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 9 birthday falls in Leo, in the second decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: The August 9 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Golden-hour warmth suits the 9th of August. Sixteen degrees into Leo, the Jupiter decan favours wisdom and benevolence, and 9 adds a humanitarian sweep. Traditional readings describe a generous mentor whose pride lies in others' success. The date is often linked with teaching, advocacy and creative work that speaks to many people at once.

Astronomically, August 9 puts the Sun near 16° Leo in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. Jupiter, the planet of Sagittarius, acts as sub-ruler for Leo from 10 to 19 degrees, which covers roughly the first ten days of August. This decan tends to add breadth and humour to the Lion's confidence. Natives are commonly pictured as big-hearted teachers, hosts and storytellers who like to share what they know and enjoy. A love of travel, ideas and grand plans often shows early. Jupiter magnifies, so the generosity can become overpromising and the confidence a little too sure of itself. When grounded, this decan tends to inspire others to think larger about their own lives.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for August 9
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an August 9 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous August 9 birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 9 is the 221st day of the year (222nd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Virgo, is usually complete within 14 days, by August 23.

By August 9 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an August 9 birthday are Whitney Houston (1963), Jean Piaget (1896) and Gillian Anderson (1968).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 9?
faq.answer: August 9 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Leo, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 9 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 9?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 9, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 9?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on August 9 include Whitney Houston (1963), Jean Piaget (1896) and Gillian Anderson (1968). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
